##### Project general facts

Burj Binghatti is an iconic ultra-luxury residential tower located in Business Bay, defined by its record-breaking height and distinctive architectural identity. Rising over 112 storeys, the tower features a striking crown-inspired pinnacle designed in collaboration with Jacob & Co, creating a bold silhouette within Dubai’s skyline. The project offers an exclusive collection of two- and three-bedroom suites, as well as exceptional penthouses and sky villas, all designed with expansive layouts, panoramic views, and a seamless blend of elegance and innovation.

Residents benefit from a curated lifestyle experience that reflects the highest standards of luxury and exclusivity. The development is designed to provide privacy, comfort, and elevated living, with premium spaces that support both relaxation and refined social living. Signature residences such as the Fleur de Jardin Sky Villas occupy half-floor layouts across upper levels, offering breathtaking 180-degree views of landmarks including Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek, creating a truly exceptional living environment.

Interiors are finished with the finest materials and meticulous attention to detail, ensuring a sophisticated and timeless aesthetic throughout each residence. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, providing functionality alongside luxury design. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while benefiting from world-class finishes and an architectural concept that sets a new benchmark for high-rise living.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and prestigious districts, positioned alongside the iconic Dubai Canal and just minutes from Downtown Dubai. Known for its striking skyline of contemporary towers, the area blends residential, commercial, and hospitality developments, creating a vibrant urban environment. Its central location ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations such as Sheikh Zayed Road, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, making it a highly desirable address for both living and investment.

The district offers a well-rounded lifestyle supported by a wide range of amenities and attractions. Residents enjoy access to waterfront promenades, fine dining restaurants, stylish cafés, retail outlets, and luxury hotels, all within walking distance. Fitness centers, wellness spaces, and landscaped public areas further enhance everyday living, while the Dubai Canal adds a scenic and tranquil element to the fast-paced city setting.

Business Bay is also known for its strong investment appeal, driven by high rental demand and continuous development. The area attracts professionals, entrepreneurs, and international residents seeking a modern, connected lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. With its combination of convenience, lifestyle offerings, and architectural presence, Business Bay stands as one of the city’s most sought-after urban destinations.
